verdict.rationale: The evidence documents invoicing, payments, and a Reports API whose named types are Invoice Details, Manual Journal Entry, and Payments Collected. Nothing in the pack mentions an accounts receivable aging report or per-customer outstanding balances. Invoicing and other report types are adjacent features, not the AR aging capability itself, so absence of evidence for this applicable accounting axis yields none.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
